Home//Hospitality

Hospitality Industry

Bring hospitality
to every interaction.

From a guest’s arrival to a patient’s welcome or a passenger’s journey, the experience starts with people. Connect service design, team capabilities and leadership to the moments that matter.

Different settings. A shared attention to people.

Hospitality in your context.

Each setting has its own expectations and pressures. Start with the experiences your organization wants to improve.

The guest experience

Hotels

Help your teams connect the details that shape a stay: a warm welcome, clear handovers and thoughtful responses to individual needs. Bring consistency across departments while making room for personal attention.

Discuss your context ↗

The patient experience

Healthcare

Support the people who welcome, listen to and guide patients and their relatives. Explore how communication, service behaviours and coordination can make everyday interactions more considerate and easier to navigate.

Discuss your context ↗

The traveller experience

Transportation

Help travellers feel informed and supported throughout their journey. Work on the handovers, information and human interactions that matter, including when delays or disruptions change their plans.

01

Improve customer journeys.

The challenge
When touchpoints and handovers do not connect, people feel the gaps. Look at the whole journey through the eyes of your guests, patients or passengers.
EHL support
Service Design ↗
Intended outcome
A clearer journey, with practical opportunities to improve touchpoints, processes and coordination.

02

Build a consistent service culture.

The challenge
A service promise becomes meaningful through everyday behaviours. Help teams connect your expectations with the situations and people they encounter.
EHL support
Service Excellence ↗Custom Programs ↗
Intended outcome
Shared service principles and relevant skills that teams can apply in their own context.

03

Support front-line leaders.

The challenge
Front-line managers set the tone for service. Give them space to develop the habits, conversations and coaching practices that support their teams.
EHL support
Service Leadership ↗Leadership programs ↗
Intended outcome
Managers better equipped to guide, coach and engage the people delivering the experience.

04

Explore new approaches together.

The challenge
A fresh perspective can help a team move forward. Step back from daily operations, question assumptions and explore how other organizations approach similar challenges.
EHL support
Workshops & Seminars ↗Study Tours ↗

A shared understanding of the challenge, new perspectives and ideas to develop together.
